items.text: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels ruled out with dislocated left elbow (X-rays negative); additional testing Monday; last similar injury cost ~4 games/month; expected to miss time.
items.why: Carted off after awkward bend; HC Quinn confirmed dislocation; Rapoport notes miss time.
items.implication: QB1 void; Marcus Mariota or backup elevated for multi-week opportunity; Commanders pass-catchers downgraded short-term.
items.opportunity: Backup QB streaming/stash; WR/TE volume may shift under new QB.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey (cracked rib) is officially ACTIVE after GTD/optimism reports and limited Friday practice; would wear flak jacket.
items.why: Official active list confirmation after Rapoport bullish tone and ETR/Levitan projecting in with docks.
items.implication: Startable WR with possible volume/efficiency docks from rib/flak; reduces need for QJ/Harris handcuffs.
items.opportunity: Full routes expected as WR1 if limited only by pain tolerance.

items.text: Broncos RB RJ Harvey (hamstring) is inactive; ETR/Levitan/Berry flagged not expected and recommended looking at Jonah Coleman.
items.why: Official inactive after weekend reports of hamstring issue.
items.implication: Handcuff/backup opportunity opens in Broncos backfield.
items.opportunity: Decent look expected for Jonah Coleman (per Levitan/Berry).

items.text: Raiders HC Klint Kubiak on TE Brock Bowers: “Close, very close. He looks great.”; Rapoport earlier noted could return next week.
items.why: HC comment post-Week 2; prior Rapoport next-week possible.
items.implication: TE1 stash/activation prep for Week 3+; Mayer/others temporary.

items.text: Bears QB Caleb Williams suffered hamstring injury; scheduled for imaging Monday; walking under own power in good spirits per reports.
items.why: In-game non-contact; Schefter/Rapoport updates; ETR watchlist.
items.implication: Week 3 availability TBD; Bears pass-catchers (Odunze/Burden/Loveland) face short-term uncertainty.
items.opportunity: Monitor backup; if misses, scheme/usage shifts for WRs/TEs.

items.text: McConkey ACTIVE confirmed; Harvey inactive—grab Jonah Coleman now (preseason advice); agrees love Germie Bernard stash (YAC man, Pittman out, good McCarthy fit).
items.why: Live active/inactive + waiver/stash endorsement matching Levitan opportunity notes.
items.implication: Immediate adds for Coleman (Harvey out) and Bernard (Pittman out) in deep leagues.
items.opportunity: Coleman backfield work; Bernard YAC/slot targets.

items.text: Packers WR Jayden Reed (neck/head) ruled OUT.
items.why: Official Packers ruling; ETR Sunday watchlist.
items.implication: GB WR targets consolidate to Watson/Wicks/Doubs etc.
items.opportunity: Increased snaps/routes for remaining Packers WRs.

items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley (stinger) questionable to return in-game.
items.implication: Monitor for multi-week if severity rises; Gainwell handcuff value.

items.text: Saints WR Chris Olave (hamstring) ACTIVE; Levitan notes sounds fine with no real docks.
items.why: Official active; ETR expected; Levitan clean projection.
items.implication: Full WR1 role without efficiency penalty expected.

items.text: Bengals QB Joe Burrow (back) officially ACTIVE after expected-to-play reports.
Projecting Ladd McConkey in with decent injury docks (RapSheet tone bullish); official status late; Puka true GTD; Olave clean no docks; Harvey->Coleman look; Pittman->Bernard look.
items.why: Player-specific docks/opportunity notes tied to ETR injury summary and Rapoport.
items.implication: McConkey startable but docked; backups elevated for absences; Olave full go.
items.opportunity: Coleman/Bernard usage spikes; McConkey routes with flak possible.

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers (hamstring) ruled OUT; Rapoport notes opens door for Rashod Bateman who started strong.
items.why: Downgraded/aggravated hamstring; confirmed in ETR weekend summary and Rapoport GameDay.
items.implication: Primary WR targets shift; Bateman elevated for volume.
items.opportunity: Bateman target/snap share spike; other Ravens WRs secondary.

items.text: Colts/PIT? WR Michael Pittman (foot) OUT; Levitan/Berry expect decent look at Germie Bernard (YAC fit).
items.why: Foot injury confirmed OUT in ETR summary.
items.implication: Slot/YAC opportunity for Bernard per Levitan (decent look) and Berry (love stash, McCarthy fit).

items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua (hip/groin soreness, unrelated to camp psoas) is true pre-game/GTD for MNF vs Giants after consecutive DNPs; Whittington doubtful.
items.why: McVay/Schefter: no practice Fri/Sat, pre-game decision; some reports trending wrong direction.
items.implication: Have pivot ready (Adams primary, then TE Ferguson/Parkinson or Mumpfield/Fields); high risk for locked lineups.
items.opportunity: If OUT, Davante Adams target spike + TE usage; if IN, full WR1.
